question: Under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Samhita (BNSS), which section mandates video-recording of search and seizure operations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Section 105**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Section 105** of the **Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Samhita (BNSS)** mandates **video-recording of search and seizure operations**. This provision ensures transparency and accountability during such operations.
 
• The objective of video-recording is to prevent any misuse of power by law enforcement agencies and to safeguard the rights of citizens during search and seizure operations.
 
• The video-recording also serves as valid proof in court proceedings, ensuring that the actions taken during the search and seizure are well-documented and follow due process.
